banner.title: gatus
banner.tagline: Probes every routed app and the WAN on their own intervals, and turns the failures into Prometheus alerts.

explainer.title: Checks come from routes and from one hand-written file

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: The gatus-sidecar watches HTTPRoutes and Services, and writes each route with a Gatus endpoint annotation into the shared config.
steps.scene: a radar sweep over a grid of route tiles

steps.title: Merge
steps.text: config.yaml adds what no route shows: the WAN, the Radarr queue, the Hermes gateway, and the ToolHive MCP session.

steps.title: Probe
steps.text: Gatus polls each endpoint on its own interval and keeps the results in SQLite on a 512 MiB ceph-block volume.
steps.scene: a probe pulse reaching a small database cylinder

steps.title: Alert
steps.text: Metrics reach Prometheus. GatusEndpointDown (external group, 5 min) is critical; GatusServiceDown (other groups, 10 min) is a warning.
steps.scene: a bell beside a warning triangle

steps.title: Show
steps.text: The status page is served on the internal Gateway. The Homepage Gatus widget reads the same API.
steps.scene: a dashboard of green and red status tiles

art.about: how an uptime checker turns route discovery and probes into alerts
art.title: How gatus discovers and probes endpoints
